per_query.question: How can I tell fretting damage from false brinelling in a bearing?
per_query.answer: Fretting damage and false brinelling can be distinguished by the pattern and conditions of the wear. Fretting marks are usually wider and do not match the shape of the rolling elements, while false brinelling marks are more uniform and can disappear after a short break-in period [en_brinelling#3].
